latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Pika AI Video Generator — Generate AI Videos from Prompts

- Generate 1080p MP4 videos from text or image prompts in 30–90 seconds.
- Supports uploads of JPG, PNG, MP4, and MOV files up to 200MB.
- Handles automatic connection, authentication, and session management with the backend.
- Provides workflows for tracking credits, session state, exporting videos, and previewing timelines.
- Includes robust error handling and clear guidance for common issues and best results.
